results.title: SQLModel tables queried with SQLAlchemy Core select on sqlite

results.title: SQLAlchemy 2.0 hybrid properties, column_property and before_flush audit events
results.summary: Map hybrid_property and column_property on SQLAlchemy 2.0 models, stamp audit timestamps with a before_flush listener, and test everything offline on in-memory SQLite.

results.title: Flask-SQLAlchemy models with Flask-Migrate upgrades on sqlite in tests
results.summary: Define Flask-SQLAlchemy models, version the schema with Flask-Migrate, and test upgrade, downgrade and model/migration drift offline on a temporary sqlite file.

results.title: factory_boy SQLAlchemy ModelFactory on in-memory sqlite
results.summary: Declare SQLAlchemy 2.0 models and factory_boy ModelFactory fixtures bound to a shared in-memory sqlite session, tested fully offline with pytest.

results.title: SQLAlchemy 2 async ORM + aiosqlite with pytest-asyncio
results.summary: SQLAlchemy 2.x typed async ORM (Mapped, mapped_column, async_sessionmaker, selectinload) on aiosqlite, with pytest-asyncio fixtures.

results.title: pandas to_sql and read_sql with a SQLAlchemy 2 engine on sqlite, with dtype handling
results.summary: Write and read DataFrames through a SQLAlchemy 2 engine, control column types with dtype, and handle datetimes and nullable ints, tested offline on in-memory sqlite.

results.title: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2 CRUD with dependency-injected sessions
results.summary: FastAPI routes backed by SQLAlchemy 2.x typed models, a per-request session dependency, and TestClient tests on SQLite.

results.title: Flask API with Flask-SQLAlchemy and marshmallow-sqlalchemy, validation errors as 422
results.summary: A Flask JSON API that loads and dumps SQLAlchemy models through SQLAlchemyAutoSchema, returns validation errors as 422, and is tested offline with the Flask test client on in-memory sqlite.

results.title: SQLAlchemy 2 async session factory over aiosqlite
results.summary: An async SQLAlchemy 2.0 engine and session factory over aiosqlite, with StaticPool in-memory wiring and pytest-asyncio tests covering commit, rollback and integrity errors.

results.title: SQLAlchemy 2 ORM rows serialized with Pydantic v2 from_attributes
results.summary: Map SQLAlchemy 2 models, expose nested relationships through Pydantic v2 schemas with from_attributes=True and a computed_field, and test them offline against in-memory SQLite.
